skill_match_score.desc: Weighted match of candidate skills to required levels

skill_gap_max.desc: Maximum deficit between member proficiency and required level

skill_coverage_ratio.desc: Proportion of required skills fully satisfied

current_utilization.desc: Current allocated hours divided by weekly capacity

projected_utilization_after_assign.desc: Projected utilization if task is assigned

task_hours_to_headroom_ratio.desc: Task hours divided by available headroom hours

hours_to_deadline_ratio.desc: Task hours divided by working hours before deadline

seniority_vs_complexity.desc: Member seniority level minus task complexity rating

collaboration_needed.desc: Whether task requires active cross-team pairing

concurrent_task_count.desc: Active in-flight tasks assigned to member
